harness.note: the real controller machine code over scripted pad input and a scripted clock; UI, sound and pad-read calls replaced by recorders. An independent Python model agreed on every exported vector.

description: Wakka's reel line classifier: what one line of three symbol numbers makes.
notes: class triples: out.results[i] is [result id, hit count] the real classifier (0x7b1710) returned for the i-th triple of in.alphabet, in nested order (first symbol slowest); all 17 x 17 x 17 triples. 0xff is an invalid symbol.
class random: out.results[i] is the same for in.lines[i], 1,500 random lines.
name: reel_line
